summary: BNB Plus Corp. filed a Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting a September 28, 2026 Second Amendment to its May 26, 2026 Registration Rights Agreement with holders of at least 50.1% of Registrable Securities, including Comstock Multichain Fund and KGPLA Holdings LLC. The amendment removes the prior 30-day registration filing deadline following the private offering's final closing and replaces it with a demand-based right: holders of at least 51% may make up to two demands, with the company required to file a resale registration statement within 45 calendar days of a demand. Signatories waived prior default claims and released the company. This is a routine contractual amendment, not a special situation; watch for registration overhang and potential selling pressure if a demand is exercised.
